The ChatGPT taskbar row now shows how long until your weekly allowance resets. **ChatGPT 28% 6d 21h** means 28% remains and the reset is in 6 days and 21 hours. The countdown advances between polls and disappears when the reset time passes.

The Devin and ChatGPT rows now line up with stacked CPU and GPU readings. Short horizontal taskbars size each provider’s column for its own text.

**Install or upgrade** — Exit NetSpeedTray, extract the entire Windows x64 portable ZIP into a new folder, and run `NetSpeedTray.exe`. The portable app is unsigned. Existing settings and sign-in carry over. To enable quotas, open **Settings → Widget → AI quotas**. The default refresh interval is 30 seconds.
